evidence: The reaction of the cobalt precursor molecule with the growing film surface was investigated by in situ quartz crystal microbalance (QCM). The thickness and step coverage of the deposited film were analyzed using cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) (JE-2100F, JEOL, Japan) images. The crystal structures of thin films were investigated by Raman spectroscopy (inVia TM Raman microscopes, Renishaw, UK) using a 514.5 nm argon ion excitation source. The composition of cobalt oxide films was measured by Auger electron spectroscopy (AES, PHI 700, ULVAC-PHI, Japan). XRD pattern of the cobalt oxide film deposited at 200 /C14 C also exhibited small metallic cobalt peak at 2 h of 44.5 /C14 (not shown in this paper).
